drawing_inputs: All inputs necessary for offline redraw are in data/. Original training arrays/model checkpoints are not needed for redraw.
interpretation: Top 30 of 383 predictors by impurity importance. Five seeds are averaged within each fold; mean and sample SD are then reported over 10 folds. The top 30 are not renormalized. Importances are nonnegative, have no activation/repression direction, and are not SHAP values or regression coefficients.
